fields.climate: temperate; moderated by North Atlantic Current; mild, windy winters; damp, cool summers
fields.terrain: mostly plateau interspersed with mountain peaks, icefields; coast deeply indented by bays and fiords
fields.hazards: earthquakes and volcanic activity; volcanism: Iceland is situated on top of a hotspot and experiences severe volcanic activity; Eyjafjallajokull (1,666 m) erupted in 2010, sending ash high into the atmosphere and seriously disrupting European air traffic…
fields.farm: milk, chicken, lamb/mutton, barley, potatoes, pork, beef, eggs, other meats, cucumbers/gherkins
fields.exports: aluminum, fish, orthopedic appliances, animal meal, iron alloys
fields.industries: tourism, fish processing; aluminum smelting; geothermal power, hydropower; medical/pharmaceutical products
fields.languages: Icelandic, English, Polish, Nordic languages, German
fields.religions: Evangelical Lutheran Church of Iceland (official) 58.6% Roman Catholic 3.8%, Independent Congregation of Reykjavik 2.6%, Independent Congregation of Hafnarfjordur 1.9%, pagan worship 1.5%, Icelandic…

independence.event: became a sovereign state under the Danish Crown

fields.legal: civil law system influenced by the Danish model
